programme.title: Something Bit Me! Compilation Season
programme.desc: The creators of the program will talk about the most terrifying animal attacks on people.The characters in subsequent episodes needed medical help due to stings, bites, infections and wounds, often life-threatening.Viewers will learn, among others:a waitress who encounters the world's largest predator on her way home, and a surfer who returned to the shore with a strange bite.In addition to the accounts of the victims, they will also hear comments from experts who will talk about the nature of wild animals and the causes of their aggression.They will also provide a scientific analysis of the facts, helping you understand the motivations of the attacking creatures.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: There is no shortage of impressive metropolises and monuments of civilization on the European continent.Regions free from human interference are particularly valuable here.Past generations have witnessed the extinction of some animal species.The six-episode documentary series contains an optimistic message that nature can regenerate.The filmmakers showed the activities of scientists who are trying to rebuild fragile ecosystems in places such as the Carpathians, Lapland and the Danube Delta.In this episode they will also visit Poland.The return of the wolf, bison and lynx Viewers will learn about the effects of the program to restore the bison population in the Romanian mountains.This species plays an important role in shaping the landscape and influences the lives of other animals.The cameras captured an exciting confrontation between a herd of these majestic deer and wolves.To learn about the situation of dog ancestors, who often fell victim to humans, the documentarians went to Poland.One of the heroes of the episode is a persistent bassist.Released in the Kampinos National Park, the wolf traveled a long way alone - only in the mountains did it find a home.The filmmakers also showed the story of Slovak lynxes, which were used to rebuild the population of this species in Germany.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind: Season 1
One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken, among others, in the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Nothing will stop ruthless predators on their way to their prey.Their survival depends on large herds of animals that have been coming to the same place year after year for millennia to quench their thirst.Lions, leopards and hyenas know perfectly well that they will not survive if they do not engage in a fierce fight to the death.The creators of the series will show this fight from a different perspective.They will present the brutal world of animals from both the predator and the prey perspective.Viewers will witness a bloody struggle for power against the background of beautiful African landscapes.They will learn the motives behind every move of the fighters and see that it is a world where no one stays on top forever, and only the strongest survive.

programme.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programme.desc: Traveler and filmmaker Bertie Gregory journeys to the poles to film wildlife in two of the harshest environments on the planet: the island of South Georgia in Antarctica and the frigid North Canada in the Arctic.You will see how the animals that inhabit these harsh areas cope and how global warming affects their habitats.You will see scenes from the lives of king and golden-crested penguins, sea lions, southern whales and petrels, as well as polar bears and wolves.Surviving in these extremely different environments requires cunning and perseverance.

programme.desc: Another installment of a fascinating series showing the fiercest clashes in the animal world.We will see extraordinary weapons and incredible tactics used by participants in the fierce fight for survival.The program presents recordings of the most powerful predators, such as lions, crocodiles and sharks, and tiny but surprisingly tough creatures, such as grasshoppers and brave insects.From the plains of Africa to the snowy wastes of North America, these are battlefields for territory, dominance and females.Thanks to elements of computer graphics, scenes presented in slow motion, close-ups and replays of key moments, viewers will not miss any detail.
